antiphon.text: The Lord is near: come, let us adore him.

shortPrayer.text: Come, Lord Jesus, and make our hearts ready for your coming.

intercessions.text: Come, Lord Jesus, and awaken your Church to hope. Hear the prayers of all who wait for your kingdom.

concludingPrayer.text: Lord Jesus Christ, awaken our hearts to your coming and make us ready to welcome you in love.

antiphon.text: Christ is born for us: come, let us adore him.

shortPrayer.text: Christ our light, remain with us and fill the world with your peace.

intercessions.text: Christ our light, bless families, the poor, and all who seek peace in your coming.

concludingPrayer.text: O God, you have made this holy night radiant with the glory of Christ; shine in our hearts and make us bearers of your peace.

antiphon.text: Come, let us return to the Lord, for he is our light and our salvation.

shortPrayer.text: Merciful Lord, teach us to return to you with a faithful heart.

intercessions.text: Merciful Father, turn our hearts to you and strengthen all who return to the Gospel.

concludingPrayer.text: Lord our God, bring us back to you with our whole heart, and renew us in the grace of your Son.

antiphon.text: This is the day the Lord has made: let us rejoice and be glad.

shortPrayer.text: Risen Lord, make us joyful witnesses of your new life.

intercessions.text: Risen Lord, make your people witnesses of joy, mercy, and new life.

concludingPrayer.text: God of life, you have raised your Son and opened for us the way to hope; keep us faithful witnesses to his resurrection.

antiphon.text: Come, let us worship the Lord, who calls us into his light.

shortPrayer.text: Faithful God, receive this day and make our work an offering of love.

intercessions.text: Faithful God, receive the work, needs, and hopes of your people this day.

concludingPrayer.text: Lord God, guide us by your wisdom and make the ordinary work of this day an offering of love.
